race.comment: ONE LAST RESORT (4) was the trendy pick in the Placid Ark and he wasn't beaten far, just 0.6L off the winner. Out to 1400m doesn't seem an issue on his last couple of performances and he now meets them all better at the weights. Can get the job done this time. LEVATI DIMEZZO (1) beat Afireofgidgeecoals two back before flying late in the Placid Ark, beaten 1L in a blanket finish. 1400m looks a big tick for him and while he'll be back in the run once more, he's sure to be sprouting wings late in the race. GAINTREE (8) was beaten a lip in the Placid Ark in a strong run from just off the speed. Her only 1400m effort was inconclusive, but she looks suited to the trip and she can be in the finish once more. COS I AM (10) continues to find trouble and her form all campaign has been rather inconclusive. Hopefully with a better gate and a rise in trip, she'll be ridden more positively and be given her chance. GODSPEED (3) can improve getting back to 1400m and into an easier race.
